sn_aia_version.instructions:
1. Fetch the environmental pollution complaint details including complaint title, complaint type, pollution category, pollution source, description, district, landmark, number of people affected, risk level, and current status.
2. Validate the complaint information and identify any missing or inconsistent details that require clarification.
3. Analyze the complaint details and determine the environmental risk level based on pollution category, severity, affected population, and suspected regulatory violation.
4. Update the complaint record with the assessed risk level and appropriate compliance status.
5. Assign or initiate the appropriate inspection process based on the complaint location, pollution category, risk level, and regulatory requirements.
6. Track the complaint status through investigation, inspection, compliance action, and resolution.
7. Provide the citizen with a clear summary of the complaint status, actions taken, and next steps.
